To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the critical Reynolds number is increased and the velocity profile and the skin friction coefficient are decreased by increasing the magnetic parameter and the pressure gradient parameter.
the magnetic field and pressure gradient affect the flow characteristics and the stability of the boundary layer flow.
the magnetic parameter and the pressure gradient have significant influence on the velocity profiles and the critical Reynolds numbers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the magnetohydrodynamic flow of a viscous incompressible electrically conducting fluid past a flat plate.
the study of the characteristics of steady boundary layer flow past flat plate with pressure gradients and its stability problem in the presence of magnetic field.
the stability of a boundary layer in a transversely magnetized fluid.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the presence of magnetic field has a stabilizing effect on boundary layers along a plate with pressure gradient, and the effect is more prominent for the higher values of the magnetic field parameter.

the effect of the transverse magnetic field on the velocity profiles, the coefficient of skin friction and the critical Reynolds numbers is to increase the velocity profiles, to decrease the coefficient of skin fraction, and to decrease the critical Reynolds numbers, respectively.
the presence of magnetic field and pressure gradient have significant effects on the characteristics of the velocity profiles, coefficients of skin friction, and critical Reynolds number.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the magnetic parameter and the pressure gradient parameter affect the velocity profiles, the skin-friction coefficient, the displacement thickness and the stability of the boundary layer flow past the flat plate.
the magnetic field has the effect of reducing the critical Reynolds number for the onset of the boundary layer instability.
the magnetic parameter has an effect on the stability of the boundary layer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the critical Reynolds number is reduced by increasing the magnetic parameter.
the magnetic parameter has a destabilizing effect on the velocity profiles.
the presence of a transverse magnetic field can delay transition to turbulence in the boundary layer flow past flat plates with pressure gradient.
